resources.string: Interactive live wallpapers · tilt · touch · play
Tilt, touch, and play — cinematic interactive wallpaper.
Could not open wallpaper picker. Long-press home screen → Wallpapers → Live wallpapers → ScreenMotion.
Lock screen static frame applied (Huawei/Honor friendly).
Lock set failed — saved a PNG and opened the system picker. Choose Lock screen.

On many Huawei and Honor phones, live wallpaper drives the home screen only.

• Live wallpaper = Home (Ana ekran)
• For Lock, ScreenMotion also applies a high-res static frame of your theme.
• If automatic apply fails, a PNG is saved and the system picker opens.

Settings → Home screen & wallpaper / Lock screen
(Ayarlar → Ana ekran ve duvar kağıdı / Kilit ekranı)

Confirm live wallpaper for Home, and the ScreenMotion still for Lock.
AOD tip: if Always-On Display is set to “Tam ekran” (Full screen), it shows a dimmed Lock wallpaper — so the static lock frame matters for AOD too.
Tilt — parallax layers, wind, and water current follow your phone.
Drag — fish, birds, and the leaf mascot rush toward your finger.
Swipe for meteors & boost · long-press for the friendly ship.
